d:
What was my kasoor? Watch Kasoor, an emotional Punjabi song in Prabh Gill's soulful voice, with lyrics by Maninder Kailey and music by The PropheC, now brought to life in a stunning new visual.
Prabh Gill's tender vocals carry every bit of the hurt of loving someone who walked away without a reason, a song for the quiet, late-night moments
Song Credits
Song - Kasoor
Singer - Prabh Gill
Music - The Prophec
Lyrics - Maninder Kailey
Label - Speed Records
